prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1404; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while the vehicle was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we may address it.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any umbrella or excess coverage, along with the name of the adjuster assigned to the claim and written confirmation of coverage positions as they are determined.

We also ask that your company and your insured preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes vehicle data and telematics, dash camera footage, photographs, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim notes, and any communications with third parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
